findings.title: Busiest Note with a recorded notice is not under test
findings.status: pending native look and owner choice
findings.detail: The busiest 900x600 guard seeds a failed rewrite through failed_rewrite, which writes a Failed Run with no Blocker attention, so the Note renders RunOutcome::Failed, not the recorded notice plus progress line that every real failure now produces. The evidence measured the realistic state on this tree: text at its 48 px floor and the writing bar 2.5 px past the Note (GPUI test text system, wider than macOS). The new writing-run-detail line is the agent's progress, not a failure reason, so the owner rule does not protect it and it could give way in the Note while the recovery card keeps it.
findings.action: Add a recorded-notice variant to the busiest-state test. Then either let writing-run-detail give way in the Note when the bar would clip (and qualify the new threads-behavior.md sentence), or take the owner's call after a native look.

findings.title: Windows native-ui compile before merge
findings.status: carried from review 1 finding 7; justified in evidence with a merge condition
findings.detail: Neither pass compiled native-ui for Windows (only aarch64-apple-darwin is installed). On a pull request, CI runs native-ui only on macos-15, so a Windows break in desktop code would first show after merge.
findings.action: Dispatch ci.yml on the PR branch and wait for the Windows and Ubuntu native-ui lanes before merging, or record the owner's explicit acceptance of the risk.
